article.hook: Not every hello needs fireworks. Sometimes, love shows up in the quiet way someone keeps their word. Venus in Capricorn asks: How does commitment look when it’s built like a contract, not a spark?
article.lived: Over the next four weeks, affection takes the shape of follow-through. You notice who remembers the small deadlines, who shows up on time and keeps promises without fanfare. It’s the colleague who drafts a plan for your joint project and the friend who checks in exactly when they said they would. This isn’t about grand declarations but about the slow stack of proof that you can count on someone beyond the hype.
article.turn: When loyalty becomes a ledger, affection feels like a transaction. Holding tight to control and expecting receipts for emotional investment turns care into a business deal. You don’t want love to be a contract negotiation with hidden clauses. Demand consistency, but don’t mistake it for safety - it can lock you in a cage of expectation.
moves: Send one message to clarify what you expect from a relationship, no matter how small.
Schedule a shared task with someone to test how commitment feels in action.
Notice and name a moment when someone’s reliability surprised you this week.

judge.weakest: Demand consistency, but don’t mistake it for safety - it can lock you in a cage of expectation.
judge.why: Strong, concrete hook and lived details; the turn names a clear, observable behavioral shadow ending with a sharp bite; moves are specific and unique to Venus in Capricorn's loyalty and commitment style.
